description: Per-map list of ambient/effect Blueprint assets that are preloaded when a battle on that map starts.

ID.simple: Map ID that owns the effect list.
ID.technical: FName row key, normally the MAP_xx key used by MapDataTable. Battle preload resolves the current map row's Id_MapEffect against MapEffectDataTables (+0x3B0) (retail 0x12bd820); NAME_None skips the join. 9 exported rows; most map rows in MapDataTable have Id_MapEffect=None, so only the maps with ambient effects have rows here.

Filename.simple: Effect Blueprint asset names used by this map.
Filename.technical: Serialized C++ property TArray<FName> FileName (16 slots in every exported row, trailing NAME_None entries). BattleAssets_MapEffects appends the array to the preload names; GamePrimaryAssetLoader_CreateLoaders creates Effect-type primary asset loaders keyed by these names into StudioMapEffectLoaders_180. Export examples for MAP_05: FX_OB_000_90111_BP, FX_OB_000_90112_BP, FX_OB_000_90311_BP. These are asset names (the _BP suffix is retained), not EffectDataTable row IDs.

notes: MapEffectDataTables is manager slot +0x3B0; 'MapEffectDataTable' is registered/resolved at GameDataTableManager.cpp:189 and line 337.

The only direct consumer found for this row struct is battle preload (0x12bd820). The loader gate at GamePhase_BattlePreload.cpp:170 waits for these effect assets before battle startup. No available code spawns them directly; their placement/activation may be in map levels or Blueprints, which are not part of this evidence set.
Export key 'Filename' corresponds to C++ FileName (case-insensitive generator match).

usages.detail: BattleAssets_MapEffects resolves Map.Id_MapEffect and appends the row's FileName list (retail 0x12bd820).
Preload looks up the current battle map row before collecting its effect assets.
Creates Effect primary asset loaders for the collected names into StudioMapEffectLoaders_180; load completion is checked at line 170.
